summary_1line: Janamejaya questions differing scriptures, leading to a narrative of Vyasa’s divine origin from Narayana and the cosmic purpose behind his birth and mission.

image_candidates.scene_text: Narayana sits upon the cosmic ocean as Brahma rises from the lotus growing from his navel.
The Goddess of Intelligence enters Brahma at Narayana’s command, filling him with the power to create the worlds.
Vyasa sits on the slopes of the Himalayas surrounded by disciples like Suka, Jaimini, and Vaisampayana as they attend their exhausted teacher.
